CONVERSATIONS.NAME: How many conversations came in?

FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME.NAME: How long did the customer wait for the first reply?
FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME.DESC: On average, from the customer writing until the first reply from a person. Lower is better.
FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME.INFO_TEXT: Average time until the first human reply to the customer. Lower is better.
FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME.TOOLTIP_TEXT: First Response Time is {metricValue} (based on {conversationCount} conversations)

FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME_AFTER_ASSIGNMENT.NAME: After reaching an agent, how long until they replied?
FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME_AFTER_ASSIGNMENT.DESC: On average, from the conversation reaching the agent until their first reply. Lower is better.
FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME_AFTER_ASSIGNMENT.INFO_TEXT: Average time until the first reply after a conversation is transferred to an agent. Lower is better.
FIRST_RESPONSE_TIME_AFTER_ASSIGNMENT.TOOLTIP_TEXT: First Response After Transfer is {metricValue} (based on {conversationCount} conversations)

RESOLUTION_TIME.NAME: How long did it take to resolve?
RESOLUTION_TIME.DESC: On average, from the first message until the conversation was marked as resolved. Lower is better.
RESOLUTION_TIME.INFO_TEXT: Average time from when a conversation opens until it is resolved. Lower is better.

RESOLUTION_COUNT.NAME: How many conversations were resolved?
RESOLUTION_COUNT.DESC: Conversations the team marked as resolved in the period.

REPLY_TIME.NAME: How long did the customer wait between messages?
REPLY_TIME.DESC: On average, each time the customer sent a message and waited for the reply. Lower is better.

ASSIGNMENT_REPORTS.DESCRIPTION: See how conversation assignments are distributed per agent — how many each person received (manually, via round-robin, or self-assigned) and how many they assigned to others.

MATRIX.TITLE: Who assigned to whom
MATRIX.HINT: Rows = who assigned · Columns = who received · values = manual assignments in the period.

SUMMARY.TITLE: Period summary
SUMMARY.COMPOSITION: Source of received: {manual}% manual · {auto}% automatic (round-robin) · {self}% self-assigned.
SUMMARY.FORWARD_ONLY: Counts start from when the feature was enabled — older periods may show as zero.

EMPTY.TITLE: No assignments in this period
EMPTY.BODY: There are no assignments recorded for the selected range. History is counted from when the feature was enabled, with no retroactive data.

LEGEND.TITLE: Understand each column
LEGEND.RECEIVED: Received — conversations assigned to this agent (they were the destination). Total is the sum of Manual + Automatic + Self-assigned.
LEGEND.RECEIVED_MANUAL: ↳ Manual: someone else assigned the conversation to this agent.
LEGEND.RECEIVED_AUTO: ↳ Automatic: the system distributed it via round-robin.
LEGEND.SELF_ASSIGNED: ↳ Self-assigned: the agent picked up the conversation themselves.
LEGEND.ASSIGNED_TO_OTHERS: Assigned → To others: conversations this agent manually assigned to someone else.
